messages:
anna: Quick poll — surge fallback UX question. If we detect a 5xx spike and start autofallback, should the default be to return a 'soft degraded' response (200 + lighter content) silently, or surface an error to caller with a reason? need a default for hosted API + Dedicated. @raj @dylan :thinking_face:

raj: lean toward silent degrade + rate-limited operator notif. customers usually prefer uptime over exactness. we can expose a `fallback_mode` config so teams can opt-in to strict errors if they want visibility.

dylan: i lean the other way for dev/debug—explicit errors are easier to triage. silent changes break correctness tests and make downstream bugs subtle. maybe silent in prod but include a header so observability still works.

maria: compliance flag — any fallback decision must be logged with trace_id, policy_id, and trigger. enterprise customers will expect >=90d retention and an audit trail. also need a console replay to show why a request was degraded.

anna: proposal: default = silent for hosted; include sampled telemetry + response header with reason so devs/operators can see it. example payload we could return: 
```
fallback_mode: "silent"
fallback_sampling: 0.01
response_headers:
  x-redwood-fallback: "model_unavailable|policy:latency_threshold"
```
This keeps user-visible uptime but preserves debuggability. thoughts?

raj: agree. we should also surface aggregated counts in operator inbox and surface a 'why-did-you-fallback' drilldown in the console (trace + policy + matching model variant). sampling lets us avoid noise while capturing examples.

deploy-bot: canary deploy 2026-06-12T14:01 triggered by @ci — no failures detected.

dylan: add an opt-in API override per-route: `?fallback=error|silent|strict` so teams can force strict behavior during staging. also return `x-redwood-fallback-sampled: 1` when sample chosen.

maria: audit event schema suggestion: `event_type=fallback_decision`, fields=[trace_id, policy_id, trigger, matched_model, fallback_variant, sampling_id, operator_ack]. surface these in logs + console export. retention/policy TBD but default 90d for Enterprise.

anna: actionable next steps: raj to prototype response header + sampling in runtime, dylan to add per-route API param + docs, maria to draft audit schema + retention note, i'll mock console drilldown (why-did-you-fallback). quick +1 if you're good.

raj: +1

dylan: +1

maria: +1
